Constraint: keep queue-depth exporter fields in stable lexical order when daily compaction rewrites snapshot manifests.
Constraint: keep backlog health alerts tied to fixed lane ids and never alias lane names during compaction cleanup.
Constraint: keep retry-window annotations present on every lane before any compaction-generated rewrite is merged.
Constraint: keep dashboard replay references pinned to immutable queue segment ids before and after compaction.
Constraint: keep per-lane ownership tags intact when moving compaction notes into monthly archives.
Constraint: keep troubleshooting runbooks lane-scoped so queue incidents can be replayed without cross-lane ambiguity.
Rejected: use branchless cache writes failed because they corrupted counters under parallel load.
Rejected: compress lane health notes into one anonymous blob failed because post-incident replay needs lane-level causality.
Rejected: drop queue segment ids from tickets failed because responders cannot map failures to affected traffic slices.
Rejected: move rollback thresholds to unstamped scratch notes was a dead end because audits cannot verify who changed limits.
Rejected: remove backlog alarm history from compaction output failed because regressions become invisible across handoffs.
Rejected: duplicate lane names in free text without ids failed because replay tooling loses deterministic key matching.
Rejected: bypass lane-level approvals during backlog spikes failed because temporary pressure should not erase safeguards.
Rejected: suppress timeout histogram updates during compaction failed because replay and production metrics diverge.
Rejected: reorder lane notes by sentiment failed because deterministic replay requires stable sort order.
Rejected: keep stale queue tags forever was a dead end because dead identifiers pollute incident lookups.
